messages:
Alex: Hey team — PR #10321 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/10321) is ready but blocked. Merge checks flagged that we need an RFC link + a short arch summary attached to the PR. TL;DR: adding a 'fallback_multitier' routing mode and a short-lived prefix eviction strategy for quantized models to avoid OOM on 32GB GPUs.

Maria: thanks Alex — do we already have an RFC URL for this, or is it just a WIP doc? I couldn't find anything in the RFC index.

Alex: There's a WIP doc I started: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/fallback-multitier-2026.md — not a full formal RFC. I wanted to get a lightweight arch blessing first, then iterate.

Ryan: @Sara (arch) can you quick-eye this and say whether the WIP doc + a 2-3 line summary on the PR is sufficient to unblock?

Sara (arch): I skimmed the doc. High-level approach looks ok. Two quick asks before I give a lightweight bless: (1) add an SLO/latency impact line (p95/p99 expectations) and (2) include a short canary + rollback plan (percent, duration, triggers). If those are in the PR description I can approve.

Alex: Got it. I'll add an SLO delta and a conservative canary plan (10% traffic, 24h, rollback on 2x error rate or >20% p95 increase). Is a perf benchmark required pre-merge or can that be post-canary?

Sara (arch): Post-canary perf samples are fine as long as the canary is conservative and the rollback triggers are explicit. Add both to PR and I'll give a lightweight arch ack.

MergeBot: automated check — PR blocked: missing RFC link in description (docs). Automerge disabled.

Alex: Updated PR description with the RFC doc link and canary details: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/10321 — pinging @Sara for bless now.

Maria: I'll take the naming/comments from the review queue after you update, Alex.

Sara (arch): Lightweight arch blessing granted. Please run the 10% for 24h canary and attach perf samples to the PR within 48h. :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks — scheduling canary and will merge once tests are green and canary slot is confirmed.
